只有元件、测试和一组输入输出。从“把图接到输出”开始，自己搭出处理图像的电路。: Just parts, tests and a set of inputs and outputs. Start from “wire the picture to the output” and build the circuits that process images yourself.
图上的一格，记一个亮度：0 是黑，1 是白。: One cell of an image, holding a brightness: 0 is black, 1 is white.
你看到的每一张图，都只是一格一格的数字。: Every image you see is just a grid of numbers, cell by cell.
图在电脑里是一张数字表，每格是一个<wiki-ref to=\"pixel\">: Inside a computer an image is a table of numbers, each cell a <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>.
把输入接到输出。: Connect the input to the output.
从「输入」右边的圆点拖到「输出」左边的圆点。: Drag from the dot on the right of “Input” to the dot on the left of “Output”.
正确。它把图往右挪一格。: Correct. It moves the image one pixel to the right.
这是一个黑箱：只能喂图、看结果。: This is a black box: you can only feed it pictures and look at what comes out.
它对图像做了什么？用测试图喂它，然后回答。: What does it do to an image? Feed it test images, then answer.
它把图像往哪个方向挪了一格？: Which way does it move the image by one pixel?
盯住一个亮点，看它去了哪里。: Follow one bright spot and see where it goes.
一个元件只做一步，几步接起来就是更大的事。: A part does one step; wire steps in a row and they do something bigger.
挪一格的元件现在归你了。: The part that moves a picture by one pixel is yours now.
把整张图往右挪两格。: Move the whole image two pixels right.
